tests.name: abi_tag_count_and_macro
tests.intent: Verify that the JSON namespace ABI macro configuration excludes view-specific simd tags and only uses the main no_simd tag.

tests.name: json_view_basic_construction
tests.intent: Verify basic creation and serialization of a json_document and json_view using public API functions.

tests.name: json_document_empty_input
tests.intent: Verify behavior of json_document with an empty input string edge case.

tests.name: json_view_number_types
tests.intent: Verify integer and floating-point number handling through json_view.

tests.name: json_view_boolean_and_null
tests.intent: Verify boolean and null parsing and query in json_view.

tests.name: json_view_array_iteration
tests.intent: Verify array traversal and element access in json_view.

tests.name: json_view_string_retrieval
tests.intent: Verify string extraction and comparison from json_view elements.

tests.name: json_view_nested_objects
tests.intent: Verify parsing and navigating nested structures via json_view.

tests.name: json_view_invalid_json
tests.intent: Verify exception behavior when parsing malformed JSON in json_document.

tests.name: json_view_find_method
tests.intent: Verify key lookup using member find functions on json_view objects.

tests.name: json_view_contains_method
tests.intent: Verify contains query on json_view objects.

tests.name: json_view_type_queries
tests.intent: Verify comprehensive type testing functions on json_view nodes.

tests.name: json_view_empty_object
tests.intent: Verify parsing of an empty JSON object boundary case.

tests.name: json_view_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of an empty JSON array boundary case.

tests.name: json_view_document_lifetime
tests.intent: Verify that json_document copy/move semantics do not break underlying views.

tests.name: json_view_integer_bounds
tests.intent: Verify extreme integer values parsing via json_view.

tests.name: json_view_whitespace_handling
tests.intent: Verify that json_view correctly handles copious whitespace in inputs.

tests.name: json_view_escaped_strings
tests.intent: Verify that string escape sequences are handled appropriately by json_view.

tests.name: json_view_multiple_keys
tests.intent: Verify objects with multiple keys iterate and resolve correctly.

tests.name: json_view_numeric_array
tests.intent: Verify arrays of numeric values via json_view element access.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Verify that explicit namespace ABI macro expansion for NLOHMANN_JSON_ABI_TAGS with NO_SIMD defined uses the updated 11-argument concat macro.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Verify that NLOHMANN_JSON_ABI_TAG_NO_SIMD is correctly expanded inside NLOHMANN_JSON_ABI_TAGS macro when JSON_NO_SIMD is active.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Verify instantiation of json_view and json_document under JSON_NO_SIMD configuration to ensure ABI tag and macro parameter folding is fully covered.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Verify that macro concatenation macro NLOHMANN_JSON_ABI_TAGS_CONCAT works correctly with 11 parameters across different translation units or preprocessor expansions.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Verify that defining JSON_NO_SIMD correctly compiles and executes json_view parsing logic matching the updated simd.hpp configuration.
